title: Ad-hoc capacity convergence checklist (weekly lightweight tracker)
content:
Purpose: quick, single-pane tracker to converge on near-term GPU/host capacity actions, SLA flags, and unblock requests across product, serving, infra, and SRE. Lightweight — intended for 10–15 minute syncs.

Last snapshot (2025-08-18):
- Reserved pool utilization (hosted): 78% avg daily, peak 94% (13:10 PT 2025-08-17)
- Dedicated commitments: 320 reserved GPUs (NVIDIA A100 equiv) — 12% headroom after scheduled tasks
- Predicted 7-day spike > current headroom: 28 GPUs (based on queued training/test runs + expected customer burst)
- Immediate risk tier: 2 endpoints flagged for latency regression if burst > 20 GPUs

Top-level ask: decide on one of the following by EOD 2025-08-19 — temporary burst request (50 GPU hours), re-route low-priority workloads to batch window, or apply short-term quota throttles for non-critical tenants.

Tracker table (rows are one-off items / experiments / temporary mitigations):
| Workstream | Owner | Action | Due | Status | Quick notes |
|-----------|-------|--------|-----|--------|-------------|
| Hosted API burst request | Arjun P. | Submit temporary burst order with cloud provider (estimate 50 GPU-hours) and update billing contact | 2025-08-19 | open | Need finance sign-off; cost estimate ~ $2.1k |
| Low-priority batch window | Maya C. | Approve schedule shift for nightly retrain jobs (move 02:00 -> 06:00 PT) | 2025-08-20 | in_progress | Prod infra ok with 06:00; check downstream CI |
| Canary routing change | Sofia A. | Add routing rule to prefer region eu-west for non-US customers for 72h | 2025-08-19 | open | Simple routing flag; watch latency SLI |
| Model quantization pilot | Liam O. | Flip quantization profile for model-x to int8 for non-critical tenants | 2025-08-22 | blocked | Need validation eval run (PR #432)
| SLA exception review | Maya C. | Convene customer success + account owners for two flagged tenants | 2025-08-21 | open | Tenants: AcmeHealth, Tradewind — both have unusual token patterns |

Lightweight metrics snapshot (for sync):
- 95th percentile latency (hosted API): 164ms (24h); target SLO 150ms
- Token cost per 1k (model-x): $0.82 — up 6% week-over-week (higher micro-batching)
- Embedding throughput backlog: 46k requests pending (avg 4h delay)

Open blockers / decisions required:
1) Finance approval for burst order (owner: Arjun) — blocker for immediate relief. JIRA-2471 tracks approvals.
2) Quick fallback plan if quantization pilot fails (owner: Liam) — need snapshot of output-delta on 5 canonical prompts.
3) Routing policy rollback plan (owner: Sofia) — define rollback trigger (latency delta > 20%).

Notes to self / meeting script for 10-min sync:
- 0:00–0:30 min: read last snapshot and confirm any new spikes
- 0:30–4:00 min: owners call out action updates (max 30s each)
- 4:00–7:00 min: decision item (burst vs. batch window vs. throttle)
- 7:00–9:00 min: assign follow-ups and dates
- 9:00–10:00 min: quick risk register update and close

One-off quick checks (ad-hoc rows — add/remove as needed):
- Quick audit: list top 10 customers by token consumption last 72h (screenshot from console) — attach after sync
- Verify no active canaries using model-x quantized path before flip
- Confirm account owners notified for any SLA exceptions

Recent changes log (edit history summary):
- 2025-08-12 created initial table and baseline metrics (Maya C.)
- 2025-08-14 added dedicated commitments data from infra report (Liam O.)
- 2025-08-17 updated peak utilization after unexpected product test burst (Arjun P.)
- 2025-08-18 moved retrain window suggestion from infra -> product-ops (Maya C.)

Unresolved questions (to surface to leadership if no quick resolution):
- If burst is approved, should we spread across regions or centralize to us-west to minimize KV-cache fragmentation? Pros/cons documented in confluence:capacity-playbook-v2
- For tenants that frequently cause spike patterns, is quota throttling acceptable or do we prefer negotiated SLAs + committed capacity?

Quick links:
- Console metric view: https://console.redwood.ai/metrics/hosted/overview
- JIRA epic: JIRA-2471
- Confluence note: confluence:capacity-playbook-v2
- PR for quantization pilot: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/432

If you add a row, please include: owner, expected delta (GPUs or QPS), rollback plan, and link to any running ticket.

(End of lightweight tracker)
